resources.string: Traffic uses the entry tunnel first and then this exit tunnel. The entry must route both 0.0.0.0/0 and ::/0. Keep both tunnels enabled. A missing or unverified hop blocks this route. Standard WireGuard exports do not include this Telos setting.
Choose another single-hop entry tunnel with full IPv4 and IPv6 routes. Loops and chains longer than two tunnels are not supported.
